jobs.title: Founding Principal Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description: About us  Most labs still count cells under a microscope by hand. It's slow, repetitive, and error-prone. We're replacing that manual work with software. By combining a standard microscope with a smartphone, we run computer vision models that locate, track, and measure cells automatically in real time. We're starting with semen analysis and expanding to other routine microscopic samples. We're a small, well-funded team in Berlin, founded in 2026. Our goal is to make automated, reliable diagnostic analysis accessible on any phone connected to a microscope.  The role  We're looking for an engineer who wants to own the whole platform behind a medical product: services, data, infrastructure, security and identity. A first version runs today. The hard part is making it trustworthy enough for clinical use: patient data that stays safe, an audit trail that holds up for years, and a system that recovers when something breaks. You'll own all of it, working closely with the founders and our CTO.

jobs.title: Environmental Compliance Manager (m/w/d) – PFAS & Kreislaufwirtschaft
jobs.description: PFASuiki setzt den globalen Standard für die sichere und nachhaltige Zerstörung von PFAS. Mit  elektrochemischer Oxidation (ECO) verwandeln wir belastete Wasserströme in ungefährliches Abwasser und helfen, eine der großen Umweltherausforderungen unserer Zeit zu lösen.  Wir suchen eine Entsorgungsfachkraft (m/w/d), die PFASuiki zum zertifizierten Entsorgungsfachbetrieb nach § 56 KrWG macht und diesen Status dauerhaft sichert. Als verantwortliche Person nach EfbV leitest und beaufsichtigst Du unsere Entsorgungstätigkeiten, erledigst alle Formalitäten mit Prüfstelle und Behörden und berätst unser Team in allen Abfall- und Entsorgungsfragen. Avery is a Hiring Intelligence Engine - AI agents that source, screen, and schedule, on a system that gets smarter with every hire. Early-stage, Amsterdam, real paying customers. You'll build Avery's core - the app and the agents that source, screen, and schedule - from idea to production. 
 Tasks 
 
 Build across the stack, from agent logic to UI 
 Ship and iterate on the core product surfaces 
 Own features end to end, real users on the other side 
 
 Requirements 
 
 A strong generalist engineer who ships 
 Comfortable with ambiguity and speed 
 Curious about applied AI and agent systems 
 
 Benefits 
 
 Real founding equity. You build it, you own a piece of it. 
 Scope most people wait years for - own your area end to end, work straight with the founder. 
 Early-stage speed: ship weekly, see your work in front of real customers, grow as fast as we do.
